scope: Content/history lint only. No release authorization.
identifier_policy: Private identifier hashes can be dictionary-matched. Supply only an external private policy; never place it in Engine or CI.
allowlist_policy: Exact path, line, rule, file-content SHA-256 and rationale are required. Owner-specific exceptions stay private. Public test exceptions may contain only independently reviewed synthetic inputs; they never grant release approval. Legacy match_sha256 fields are rejected.
diagnostics: CLI outputs aggregate counts only. In-process detailed results remain private.
